result.note: Tests the bilateral mechanism Jaishankar co-chaired in Russia in August 2026 (the IRIGC-TEC).

questions.prompt: In August 2026, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar visited Russia to co-chair the 27th session of which bilateral mechanism?
options: India-Russia Inter-Governmental Commission on Trade, Economic, Scientific, Technological and Cultural Cooperation (IRIGC-TEC)
Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Council of Foreign Ministers
questions.explain: Jaishankar travelled to Russia on 23-24 August 2026 to co-chair the 27th IRIGC-TEC at the invitation of First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov. During the visit he was also to meet Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov on regional and global issues.
questions.source: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar will visit Russia on August 23-24 to co-chair the 27th India-Russia Inter-Governmental Commission on Trade, Economic, Scientific, Technological and Cultural Cooperation (IRIGC-TEC), at the invitation of First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov.
